enchantment.additional_enchantments.clim: Allows you to climb on walls and perhaps even ceilings
enchantment.additional_enchantments.perc: Marks certain entities or valuable items with a glowing border
enchantment.additional_enchantments.flui: Improves your vision through and within certain fluids
enchantment.additional_enchantments.gree: Merely walking allows nearby crops to grow and grass to flourish
enchantment.additional_enchantments.homi: Causes projectiles to home in on certain entities
